Name: Proxy_Attr
Description: Will duplicate and connect all proxy attrs from desire transform

attrs.Help_string:
Overview:
  Will duplicate and connect all proxy attrs from desire transform.

How To Use:
  fill the key fields below before build.

Fields:
- SetParent: set the target node name.
- If left as default, the tool uses placeholder behavior for setup.
- CtrlShape: choose one option (for example: cross, gear, hexagon, octagon).
- SetCopyAttrsFrom: set the node/object name this block should use.
- Template parent examples: L_Hand_Ankle_Jnt, L_Hand_Palm_Jnt, Spine_End_Jnt.

Tips:
- start with defaults, build once, then tweak only the fields you need.
